integrity.not_proved: Multiplicity of jet components, full scheme structure, arbitrary finite local rings, or independent validation.
integrity.proved: All-length geometrically irreducible component census with common dimension over arbitrary fields; exact number of square-zero matrices over finite commutative chain rings.
integrity.verification: Three standalone exhaustive finite checks with recorded outputs; these are not infinite proofs.

scientific_limitations: Only three-by-three square-zero matrices; geometry of reduced underlying jet schemes only, not nonreduced multiplicities or higher matrix sizes. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Equidimensional jets of the square-zero \(3\times3\) matrix scheme
